name: Postman
description: Postman lets agents read and update workspaces, collections, environments, and API specifications in the user's Postman account. Each user signs in to their own Postman account through the browser.

prompts.text: List the collections in my team workspace.
Write documentation for the requests in my Payments API collection.
Add a GET request for /users/{id} to my Users collection.

apps.name: Postman
apps.description: Workspace, collection, environment, and spec access, over Postman's MCP server with browser sign-in.
